facts.text: Bishan was once land belonging to Kwong Wai Siew Peck San Theng, a cemetery that served Cantonese and Hakka communities.
Bishan (BEE-shahn), also known as Peck San, is a planning area and residential town located at the northernmost portion of the Central Region of Singapore.
HDB planned 24,600 units across Bishan East, North, West, and Shunfu, with Bishan East becoming the largest neighbourhood.
Bishan hosts Ai Tong School, founded by Chinese pioneers in 1912, and Catholic High School, whose alumni include Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
Several major national and international level sporting events have been held at the Bishan Sports Centre, including the 2009 Asian Youth Games and the 2010 Youth Olympic Games.
Bishan MRT station serves as an interchange between the North–South and Circle Lines.
